notes.title: Backrooms Exploration Update v1.3 “The Renewal” Update out now!
notes.notes:
Backrooms Exploration The Renewal v1.3 Update Now Live!
LIMINAL MODE COMING IN UPDATE V1.4!!
(Game has been updated heavily so previous saves of the game may not work correctly)

We have completely revamped the game with updated graphics, better looking levels, improved sound effects, better game mechanics all for a smoother player experience! Liminal Mode will be releasing in the next update v1.4!

General Fixes –
Visual
- Removed Pixel Dissolve Effect (TV Moving Static)
- Pixel Distortion Lessened
- Vignette Fix
- Updated Monster Visuals
- Updated Lighting to Lumen
- Many More Graphical Improvements

Mechanics
- Moved Equipment basket on top of a crate on every level
- Added Sanity

- Updated Monster Audio
- Fixed Footstep Audio
- Added Backrooms Exploration Soundtrack
- Changed Character Voice
- Updated Options Sounds
- Fixed Music Slider Options

notes.title: BACKROOMS EXPLORATION V1.3 THE RENEWAL UPDATE COMING SOON...
notes.notes:
BACKROOMS EXPLORATION V1.3 THE RENEWAL UPDATE COMING SOON...
-
Hello everyone!

It has been a while, but we are in the works of creating a way better and more enjoyable game than before! We are completely revamping the game with new visuals, better graphics, smoother mechanics, more secrets and much much more content!

Stay tuned for the announcement of the release date of this update!
-
Mistcloud Games

notes.title: BACKROOMS EXPLORATION THE OVERHAUL UPDATE
notes.notes:
BACKROOMS EXPLORATION THE OVERHAUL UPDATE

(SAVES HAVE POTENTIAL TO BE RESET. THIS WILL BE THE ONLY TIME THIS HAPPENS AS IT IS NEEDED TO ENABLE FUTURE UPDATES AND MAKE THE GAME BETTER! WE HOPE YOU UNDERSTAND)

General Fixes
-	Jumpscares Volume Lowered
-	TESTBUILD.EXE changed to BackroomsExploration.EXE
-	Changed Paper image/text in-game
-	Added Instructions to Puzzles (Mini Games such as Pick-locking)
-	Can Exit Puzzles with ‘R’ Key
-	Added UI to help the player distinguish puzzles they need to interact with
-	Added Instructions to Puzzles
-	Updated Diary text
-	Removed Unnecessary Item Descriptions
-	Gave Items simple names
-	Player Run Speed Increase 350 > 1000
-	Player Walk Speed Increase 150 > 500
-	Keys now only require you to right click to open doors
-	Added Basic Options Settings
-	Fixed all Escape Instructions to make it easier and clearer (Paper at the start of levels)
-	Changed Main Menu Graphics
-	Added Resource Bucket to every level

-	Fixed Walls Bound Scales

LEVEL 1 –
-	Fixed Overlapping Textures, Items, and Actors

-	Lowered Puzzle 1 Gas Damage

-	Changed Lighting Colour
-	Fixed PC Puzzle Bugged Text

-	Radar Scanner Instructions Added

notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has supported us through this journey! We are very grateful and give you the finalized release date for our game BACKROOMS EXPLORATION!!
